note: Hôtel des Voyageurs first-floor lounge (Le salon du premier), camera at the top of the main staircase. Landmark: marble fireplace with the gilt mirror. Feminine LEFT: animal band riding a neighing pony (tournée), donkey with picnic baskets and a guide flag (excursion), poodle posing on the rows of little gold chairs (disposition). Centre: mouse with three cameras squealing at the Eiffel Tower model (touristique, adj). Masculine RIGHT: goose with a long fluttering itinerary (itinéraire), badger in a suit dragging a huge suitcase that rucks up the rug (déplacement), garden pavilion with a peacock seen through the arched window (pavillon). Exits: stairs down (near left) -> R_hotel_01; open double doors (back left) -> breakfast room R_hotel_02_z1; narrow stairs up (back right) -> R_hotel_03. Painted 2026-10-22.
